# SEO & AI Visibility Check by SlickLab.Digital

> A free tool that checks whether search engines and AI assistants can reach, read and correctly describe a website, then lists the five most important fixes with ready-to-paste files.

## What it checks

- robots.txt rules for search and AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others), noindex tags and bot walls
- Whether page content is in the raw HTML or only appears after JavaScript runs
- Structured data (schema.org), sitemap.xml and llms.txt
- Facts that disagree, such as phone numbers or countries served, text that tries to steer AI, and Google spam-policy risks

## Using it

- [Run a check](https://seo.slicklab.digital/): paste a homepage address and get results in 20 to 40 seconds. Free, 5 checks per hour per visitor, results are not stored.
